routes.title: The Sad Eyes Beneath the Mask

rows.en: ...Then you are ordering us to seize it by force?
rows.notes: Meio questions Dorchenov's order; subordinate uses a polite full question.

rows.en: Correct. The Institute of Space Science may be a civilian facility, but it cooperates with the Earth Federation...
rows.notes: Dorchenov answers Meio; acknowledges civilian status before alleging Federation collaboration.

rows.en: Their research on aliens is being submitted to the Federation Army. There is no telling when it may become a threat to us.
rows.notes: Dorchenov continues justification; alien research is sent to Federation and may threaten Giganos.

rows.en: And above all, that institute is barely armed...
rows.notes: Dorchenov boasts of target vulnerability; barely armed, not wholly defenseless.

rows.en: It is the perfect target to strike as a warning to companies and civilian research facilities that cooperate with the Federation.
rows.notes: Dorchenov plans exemplary attack aimed at Federation collaborators; all target types retained.
Intentional silence. Meio silent under orders; silence deliberately retained.

rows.en: You seem dissatisfied. But I did not choose the Institute of Space Science as our target for no reason.
rows.notes: Dorchenov reads Meio's dissatisfaction and defends target choice.

rows.en: If we attack it, the Nahel Argama may come with the D-Weapons aboard, and things may turn in our favor.
rows.notes: Dorchenov imagines attacking institute drawing Nahel Argama and D-Weapons; possibility retained.

rows.en: Then why don't we simply attack that ship head-on...?
rows.notes: Private objection to Dorchenov, not spoken aloud. Meio privately questions indirect tactics; thought framing retained.

rows.en: Do not forget, Captain Plato... It was your father who sold the D-Weapons to the Federation.
rows.notes: Dorchenov blames Meio's father for selling D-Weapons; Captain Plato addresses Meio.

rows.en: You seem to throw your weight around as Marshal Guiltorre's favorite...
rows.notes: Dorchenov accuses Meio of exploiting Guiltorre's favor; trailing accusation retained.

rows.en: But I do not trust you in the slightest. Do not forget that.
rows.notes: Dorchenov emphasizes personal distrust of Meio and warning.

rows.en: I have dedicated myself solely to the ideals His Excellency the Marshal upholds.
rows.notes: Meio formally professes loyalty to Marshal's ideals.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... I know exactly what you are thinking.
rows.notes: Dorchenov contemptuously claims to know Meio's mind; mocking laugh retained.

rows.en: Listen. If you wish to clean up your father's mess and clear your own name, destroy the D-Weapons.
rows.notes: Dorchenov demands victory to repair father's disgrace and Meio's reputation.

rows.en: Understood, sir.
rows.notes: Meio formally acknowledges Dorchenov's order.

rows.en: If your failures continue, I will consider demoting you and forcibly sending you back to our homeland on the Moon.
rows.notes: Dorchenov threatens consideration of demotion and forced lunar repatriation; conditional retained.

rows.en: Now then... I expect fine results from you, son of a traitor.
rows.notes: Dorchenov parts with expectation and traitor's-son insult aimed at Meio.

rows.en: How dare he call the Captain, of all people, a traitor!
rows.notes: Welner vents after Dorchenov departs; Captain is Meio.

rows.en: I can't forgive him...! And how dare he order us to carry out such a shameless operation!
rows.notes: Both outrage and shameless-order accusation retained. Karl condemns insult and shameless mission; both statements retained.

rows.en: Enough. As soldiers, we must obey orders from above without question.
rows.notes: Meio silences squad and invokes absolute military obedience.

rows.en: But, Captain! I cannot accept that a vulgar wretch like that serves on the staff of our Giganos military!
rows.notes: Dan objects to Dorchenov's vulgarity and staff position in their own military.

rows.en: I hear that back home on the Moon, young officers are growing increasingly dissatisfied with his corruption and that of the high command.
rows.notes: Karl reports lunar junior-officer discontent with Dorchenov and corrupt senior command.

rows.en: This is surely all a result of the stalemate in the war.
rows.notes: Welner attributes that discontent to prolonged military stalemate.

rows.en: Say no more. To realize Marshal Guiltorre's ideals, we must employ even men like him.
rows.notes: Meio stops criticism and argues even such men serve Guiltorre's ideals.

rows.en: Likewise, soldiers on the front lines must sometimes deliberately commit acts of brutality.
rows.notes: Retains explicit brutality, not softened to tough choices. Meio extends argument to frontline brutality; explicit acts of brutality retained.

rows.en: Like the Gon Jem Squad... is that what you mean, sir?
rows.notes: Welner asks if Meio means Gon Jem Squad; refers to previous brutality statement.

rows.en: I... believe our military should be led by someone like you, Captain...
rows.notes: Dan trails off while implicitly proposing Meio as leader. Dan cautiously suggests Meio as rightful military leader; deliberate trailing thought retained.

rows.en: ...Practice Squad, prepare to sortie.
rows.notes: Addresses the full Practice Squad. Meio redirects Practice Squad to sortie preparation.

rows.en: Beyond Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov's intentions and drawing out the D-Weapons, there is another reason to seize that facility.
rows.notes: Meio distinguishes independent intelligence purpose from Dorchenov motives and D-Weapons diversion.

rows.en: Do you mean information about aliens, sir?
rows.notes: Question restores information-seeking verb. Karl asks whether additional purpose is alien intelligence; restores full question verb.

rows.en: Correct. The Earth Federation is no longer our only enemy. There is the Vegan Empire, and above all...
rows.notes: Deliberate continuation into row32; above all points to Gulfer. Meio confirms and introduces Vegan Empire, then more pressing enemy in following row.

rows.en: We must also fight the force calling itself Gulfer that has appeared on the Moon.
rows.notes: Meio identifies Gulfer on Moon as enemy they too must fight.

rows.en: Yes, sir. I hear that we Giganos, the Federation, and Gulfer are locked in a standoff on the lunar surface.
rows.notes: Welner reports three-way lunar standoff among Giganos, Federation, Gulfer.

rows.en: As a stopgap measure, the Federation Army seems to have sealed off the area surrounding Gulfer's enormous fortress...
rows.notes: Welner reports provisional Federation cordon around huge Gulfer fortress; tentative report retained.

rows.en: If the balance of power among those three... or four, counting the Vegan Empire, whose home base is still unknown, collapses...
rows.notes: Conditional continues into row36; includes unknown Vegan base. Meio describes conditional collapse of three/four-power balance; unknown Vegan base retained.

rows.en: The course of the war will change in an instant. This mission is to gather intelligence on our enemies in preparation for that day.
rows.notes: Meio completes conditional consequence and explains mission as future-oriented intelligence collection.

rows.en: So our actions will bring Giganos victory tomorrow, sir?
rows.notes: Karl asks if current actions secure tomorrow's Giganos victory.

rows.en: Every soldier on the front lines shares that hope. Never forget that.
rows.notes: Meio says all frontline soldiers share that hope; full subject restored.

rows.en: Yes, sir!
rows.notes: Karl acknowledges Meio.

rows.en: ...But how much longer does Marshal Guiltorre intend to stand by and watch this situation?
rows.notes: Dan questions how long Guiltorre will wait and observe.

rows.en: He will act when the time comes. But...
rows.notes: Deliberate hesitation; Guiltorre is subject from row40. Meio predicts Guiltorre will act at right time; deliberately trails off.

rows.en: Is something troubling you, sir?
rows.notes: Karl asks Meio if something is troubling him; verb restored.

rows.en: No... First, we must do everything we can to seize the Institute of Space Science.
rows.notes: Meio deflects concern and prioritizes all-out seizure of institute.

rows.en: Then we will defeat the D-Weapons... and embody the unbreakable unity of Giganos.
rows.notes: Meio urges defeating D-Weapons to demonstrate Giganos unity.

rows.en: Understood, sir!
rows.notes: Welner formally acknowledges.

rows.en: ...Your Excellency... The situation facing the Earth and our people has already become too uncertain to predict.
rows.notes: Thought addressed mentally to Guiltorre. Meio privately addresses Guiltorre; Earth and Giganos situation admits no confident prediction.

rows.en: Where does the path forward lie for us... and for all humanity...?
rows.notes: Includes both Giganos and humanity. Meio privately wonders what path Giganos and humanity should take.

rows.en: Vega, what did you want to talk to me about?
rows.notes: Daisuke asks Vega why she summoned him.

rows.en: I'm sorry I called you all the way here. There is something I wanted to ask you...
rows.notes: Vega apologizes for summons and introduces a question.

rows.en: What is it?
rows.notes: Daisuke asks Vega what question she has.

rows.en: It's about who you really are.
rows.notes: Vega explicitly asks about Daisuke's true identity.

rows.en: ...Dr. Genzo Umon of the Institute of Space Science helped us in many ways when GEAR was founded...
rows.notes: Doctor identified as Genzo Umon; preserves GEAR acronym. GEAR organization acronym confirmed centrally from Akurasu SRW R Secrets; no expansion. Vega recalls Genzo Umon helping establish GEAR; organization acronym retained.

rows.en: I've met the doctor and spoken with him several times myself.
rows.notes: Vega establishes direct meetings and conversations with doctor.

rows.en: What about it?
rows.notes: Daisuke asks what relevance this has.

rows.en: The last time we met was about three years ago... He didn't have a son then.
rows.notes: Doctor did not have a son when Vega last met him. Vega contrasts doctor having no son three years earlier with Daisuke present.

rows.en: Who are you, really? And that Grendizer... I can't believe it's a super robot built on Earth...
rows.notes: Vega challenges identity and doubts Grendizer is Earth-built super robot.

rows.en: Could it be that you're...?
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished suspicion about Daisuke being an alien. Vega trails off while suspecting alien origin; suspicion not turned into explicit revelation.

rows.en: ...I'm Daisuke Umon, an Earthling.
rows.notes: Daisuke asserts Earthling cover identity. Daisuke asserts Daisuke Umon/Earthling cover identity.

rows.en: As I thought... There is a limit to how long I can hide the truth.
rows.notes: Restores Daisuke as subject hiding truth. Daisuke privately recognizes inability to conceal truth indefinitely.

rows.en: But that woman, Vega... Something about her feels different from an Earthling.
rows.notes: Vega is sourced female; atmosphere differs from an Earthling. Daisuke privately notes Vega's non-Earthling atmosphere; sourced female pronoun used.

rows.en: Could she be one, too...?
rows.notes: One refers to an alien, deliberately speculative. Daisuke wonders if Vega too is an alien; speculative one preserves unfinished comparison.

rows.en: Daisuke!
rows.notes: Koji calls Daisuke, interrupting private reflection.

rows.en: What's wrong, Koji?
rows.notes: Daisuke asks what brings Koji.

rows.en: Dr. Genzo Umon just contacted us. He said he wants you to come back to the institute, Daisuke.
rows.notes: Koji relays Dr. Genzo Umon asking Daisuke to return; retains doctor title. Full-name glossary spelling. Koji conveys doctor's request for Daisuke to return to institute.

rows.en: He wants me...?
rows.notes: Restores wants me from Koji report. Daisuke confirms request is for him; wanting restored explicitly.

rows.en: Yeah. Apparently he has something important to discuss that he can't talk about over the comm...
rows.notes: Koji explains confidential important business cannot be discussed by communications.

rows.en: All right. I'll explain the situation to Captain Bright and go to the institute.
rows.notes: Daisuke decides to explain to Bright and visit institute; I restored for both actions.

rows.en: ...Hey, Judau. Do you know where Hokuto went?
rows.notes: Ginga asks Judau for Hokuto's whereabouts.

rows.en: Hokuto? I don't know...
rows.notes: Restores I do not know rather than bare uncertainty fragment. Judau does not know where Hokuto is; full English response restored.

rows.en: I saw him on Deck 2.
rows.notes: Hokuto is referent from neighbor questions. Iino saw Hokuto on Deck 2; male referent sourced.

rows.en: Deck 2? Where's that?
rows.notes: Ginga asks where Deck 2 is.

rows.en: Then we'll take you there.
rows.notes: We is Judau and Iino. Judau offers to escort Ginga with Iino; we direction retained.
Source silence retained.

rows.en: Ah, there he is.
rows.notes: There he is refers to Hokuto. Judau spots Hokuto on deck; subject he restored.

rows.en: Huh? Hokuto, what's wrong?
rows.notes: Ginga asks Hokuto what is wrong.

rows.en: No, it's nothing.
rows.notes: Hokuto denies anything is wrong. Hokuto dismisses concern, claiming nothing is wrong.

rows.en: Nothing...? You look pretty down. Are you all right?
rows.notes: Iino challenges nothing response because Hokuto looks depressed, then asks wellbeing.

rows.en: Oh... You're worrying about why we're fighting and all that again, aren't you?
rows.notes: Ginga identifies renewed brooding about reason to fight.

rows.en: I guess I... might not be able to make peace with it the way you can.
rows.notes: Hokuto compares his doubts with Ginga; later rows distinguish Gulfer defense from war. Hokuto admits he cannot compartmentalize like Ginga; later context distinguishes war from self-defense.

rows.en: Aaargh, come on! Once you've made up your mind, quit whining about it, you little worrywart!
rows.notes: Keeps irritated childish insult and repeated doubts. Ginga snaps at repeated doubts despite prior decision; childish insult retained.

rows.en: The Gulfer are attacking us, so we've got no choice but to fight!
rows.notes: Ginga presses Hokuto about defending against Gulfer; restores we as fighters.

rows.en: I know that. I'm not going to hesitate to fight the Gulfer, either.
rows.notes: Hokuto distinguishes defense against Gulfer from human war.

rows.en: But fighting a war...
rows.notes: Hokuto deliberately trails off about war; retained fragment.

rows.en: ...I know how you feel, Hokuto.
rows.notes: Judau addresses Hokuto sympathetically.
Hokuto's nonverbal surprise retained.

rows.en: Iino and the rest of us got caught up in the war before we knew it, too.
rows.notes: Judau describes his group's accidental involvement.

rows.en: Well, trying to steal the Zeta Gundam from the Argama was our own fault, but...
rows.notes: Judau sheepishly admits the cause; deliberate trailing contrast.

rows.en: That's a crime, though.
rows.notes: Ginga reacts bluntly to the theft.

rows.en: We didn't have a choice if we wanted to survive in Shangri-La.
rows.notes: Judau defends the theft as survival; stray closing wrapper ignored.

rows.en: It was a tough place for anyone who couldn't get by on their own. Not like Earth.
rows.notes: Judau contrasts colony life with Earth; rhetorical final fragment retained.

rows.en: O-oh, right... You have to buy your water and air in a colony, don't you?
rows.notes: Ginga recognizes the colony's living costs; stray wrapper ignored.

rows.en: ...Are you and your friends fighting a war just to survive, Judau? Have you gotten used to it already?
rows.notes: Hokuto asks Judau's group both motivation and habituation.

rows.en: I'd be lying if I said I hadn't gotten used to it.
rows.notes: Judau concedes habituation, answering Hokuto.

rows.en: But I figure it's still better than worrying and doing nothing... Better than dying without being able to do anything.
rows.notes: Judau justifies action over helpless death; second comparative is deliberate continuation.

rows.en: I-I just... I don't understand that!
rows.notes: Hokuto emotionally rejects Judau's outlook; subject restored.

rows.en: H-hey! Hokuto!
rows.notes: Ginga calls after Hokuto as he leaves.

rows.en: ...Is he going to be all right?
rows.notes: Iino worries about Hokuto, male per glossary.

rows.en: Who knows?
rows.notes: Judau's colloquial uncertainty; impersonal idiom.

rows.en: W-what do you mean, who knows...?
rows.notes: Ginga challenges Judau's response.

rows.en: Whatever happens, he's got to find his own clear answer to that sort of problem.
rows.notes: Judau says Hokuto must resolve his doubts himself.

rows.en: Otherwise, it'll get him killed someday.
rows.notes: Judau warns unresolved doubts will become fatal to Hokuto.
Silent reaction preserved.

rows.en: That's right. The Earth Federation is no longer our only enemy.
rows.notes: Meio's enemy assessment occurs at a scene shift; repeated route rows40-47 checked.

rows.en: Hey, Daisuke.
rows.notes: Koji greets Daisuke; repeated route context63-66 checked.

rows.en: All right. I'll explain the situation to Captain Bright and go to the institute.
rows.notes: Daisuke answers Umon's request relayed by Koji.

rows.en: Be really careful out there, Daisuke.
rows.notes: Koji warns Daisuke before departure.

rows.en: Grendizer has launched.
rows.notes: Saegusa reports departure from the ship.

rows.en: Understood. We'll take up patrol duty around point M1334.
rows.notes: Bright assigns his own force patrol duty; alphanumeric location unchanged.

rows.en: Captain... We've had reports of Vegan Empire scout craft appearing near the Nasu Highlands lately.
rows.notes: Douglas warns Bright about the destination's vicinity. Nasu Highlands centrally verified against official JNTO.

rows.en: Are you sure we should let him go alone?
rows.notes: Douglas asks Bright about Daisuke; male confirmed by glossary.

rows.en: I've asked the military radar sites to keep a special watch on that airspace...
rows.notes: Bright explains precautions already requested.

rows.en: If anything happens, we'll head over there ourselves.
rows.notes: Bright promises the force will respond to danger.

rows.en: Then I'll use Maggie to link up with the radar site network. That way, we'll get the information as soon as it comes in.
rows.notes: Light offers D-3 computer linkage for rapid reports. Radar site network source-literal, anchored by preceding military radar sites; no invented acronym.

rows.en: Yes, she should be able to... I'm counting on you, Airman Third Class Newman.
rows.notes: Douglas refers to Maggie as she because source explicitly personifies computer; request direction restored.

rows.en: Leave it to me.
rows.notes: Light accepts Douglas's request; source is his offer.

rows.en: Dad, I'm back.
rows.notes: Daisuke addresses adoptive father Umon.

rows.en: I'm glad to see you're doing well, Daisuke.
rows.notes: Umon warmly welcomes Daisuke.

rows.en: So, what did you want to talk to me about...?
rows.notes: Daisuke begins asking about the summons; question trailed by Hikaru's entrance.

rows.en: Daisuke, you're back at the institute!?
rows.notes: Hikaru surprised by Daisuke's return.

rows.en: Hikaru, what brings you here...?
rows.notes: Daisuke asks why Hikaru has come.

rows.en: Hey, Daisuke! Is that how you greet us after all this time!?
rows.notes: Danbei scolds Daisuke's distant greeting.

rows.en: You're here too, sir...?
rows.notes: Daisuke notices Danbei; respectful familiar adult address without inventing kinship.

rows.en: What's happened, Danbei?
rows.notes: Umon asks Danbei why they arrived.

rows.en: A UFO! A UFO! I saw a UFO!
rows.notes: Danbei's excited repeated claim; subject restored.

rows.en: I saw it too. It was the same kind as the one that appeared near here before.
rows.notes: Hikaru corroborates Danbei's sighting.

rows.en: A UFO from the Vegan Empire...!
rows.notes: Daisuke's thought identifies suspected affiliation; noun fragment expresses recognition.

rows.en: Danbei, please stay here in the institute for now. Something dangerous may happen.
rows.notes: Umon requests protective shelter, no certainty of an attack added.

rows.en: I can't just stay here. Daisuke, you're coming with me.
rows.notes: Danbei refuses shelter and orders Daisuke along.

rows.en: Coming with you...? What happened?
rows.notes: Daisuke questions Danbei's demand; echoes it as a fragment.

rows.en: All that fuss over the UFO scared off Silver, the finest horse on our ranch.
rows.notes: Danbei explains horse's escape. Silver centrally verified as the named Grendizer horse; no sex inferred.

rows.en: We've got to go look right away... Silver shouldn't have gotten very far yet.
rows.notes: Hikaru wants immediate search; neutral horse reference, no inferred sex. Silver centrally verified as the named Grendizer horse; no sex inferred.

rows.en: ...I'm sorry, Hikaru. I've got something else to do.
rows.notes: Daisuke refuses because of other duties.

rows.en: Something else...? You loved Silver too, didn't you? So why won't you help?
rows.notes: Hikaru explicitly asks why Daisuke refuses the horse search. Silver centrally verified as the named Grendizer horse; no sex inferred.

rows.en: Forget that coldhearted fellow! I'll go look on my own!
rows.notes: Danbei dismisses Daisuke and declares search alone.

rows.en: Oh, Dad!
rows.notes: Hikaru calls after Danbei.

rows.en: Hikaru, I'm worried about that UFO. You need to stay here at the institute.
rows.notes: Daisuke orders Hikaru to remain for safety.

rows.en: ...You've changed, Daisuke...
rows.notes: Hikaru accuses Daisuke of emotional distance.

rows.en: Where have you been all this time? You never even told us where you were going.
rows.notes: Hikaru asks about Daisuke's absence and secrecy.

rows.en: I... can't tell you.
rows.notes: Daisuke refuses to disclose whereabouts.

rows.en: Why? Why won't you tell me?
rows.notes: Hikaru presses for an explanation.

rows.en: Hikaru, Daisuke was out taking care of something for me.
rows.notes: Umon covers for Daisuke's absence.

rows.en: Was it something you had to keep secret from us?
rows.notes: Hikaru challenges Umon's cover story; plural us preserved.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: I'm sorry, Hikaru...
rows.notes: Daisuke's silent apology retained as thought.

rows.en: I can't let any of you find out that I'm from Planet Fleed...
rows.notes: Daisuke's thought explains true identity must remain hidden from Hikaru's family.

rows.en: For my sake... And for yours and your family's, Hikaru...
rows.notes: Daisuke's deliberately unfinished continuation gives motive for secrecy; source fragment retained.

rows.en: Tell me, Daisuke. Where have you been?
rows.notes: Hikaru repeats her demand for whereabouts.

rows.en: I can't tell you... I just can't.
rows.notes: Daisuke's repeated refusal has restored subject and verb.

rows.en: I've had enough!
rows.notes: Hikaru dismisses the exchange in anger.

rows.en: Wait, Hikaru.
rows.notes: Daisuke asks Hikaru to stop leaving.

rows.en: The Daisuke standing here now isn't my Daisuke! You're someone else!!
rows.notes: Hikaru emotional rejection; my denotes personal bond, not added relationship status.

rows.en: Hikaru...!
rows.notes: Daisuke calls after Hikaru.

rows.en: Are you sure about this, Daisuke?
rows.notes: Umon asks whether Daisuke accepts the rupture with Hikaru.

rows.en: ...Yes.
rows.notes: Daisuke answers Umon's question; response fragment retained.

rows.en: I'd braced myself for this day from the moment I got back into Grendizer...
rows.notes: Daisuke says he prepared for this rupture when resuming piloting. Meaning correction after draft: braced myself preserves resigned preparation, rather than mere prediction.

rows.en: Now I'm Daisuke Umon, but I'm Duke Fleed at the same time.
rows.notes: Daisuke states both identities, preserving simultaneous status.

rows.en: ...And as Duke Fleed, there are things I have to do.
rows.notes: Daisuke affirms duty belonging to his true identity.

rows.en: I see.
rows.notes: Umon accepts Daisuke's resolve.

rows.en: So, Dad... What did you want to talk to me about?
rows.notes: Daisuke returns to original purpose of summons.

rows.en: Yes. Actually, for the past few days... someone's been snooping around the institute.
rows.notes: Umon reports suspicious activity; identity and gender unspecified here.

rows.en: Could it be a spy from the Vegan Empire...!?
rows.notes: Daisuke suspects enemy espionage, uncertain question preserved.

rows.en: The guards say it was a woman... Or rather, a girl still in her teens.
rows.notes: Umon specifies female teen explicitly based on guards' report.

rows.en: You can't be sure. Female commanders aren't unusual in the Vegan Empire.
rows.notes: Daisuke replies to Umon's young-female-spy report; a woman's age does not rule out Vegan command rank.

rows.en: But what troubles me... is that the girl apparently had eyes that looked like yours.
rows.notes: Umon reports the girl's resemblance specifically around her eyes; listener is Daisuke.
Wordless shocked reaction; punctuation-only fragment retained, no invented speech.

rows.en: ...Do you have someone in mind?
rows.notes: Umon asks Daisuke whether the resemblance suggests anyone he knows.

rows.en: It couldn't be...!
rows.notes: Daisuke's thought reaction to possible sister survival; sister is identified explicitly in row167.

rows.en: No, that's impossible...! She couldn't still be alive and here on Earth...!
rows.notes: Thought about his sister; feminine pronoun comes from source sister/she, not her name.

rows.en: Back then... I...
rows.notes: Deliberately interrupted thought opening; I and the trailing ellipsis retained.

rows.en: I left her to die as she screamed in the flames... My little sister...
rows.notes: Daisuke's guilty recollection; source identifies the crying girl as his younger sister; his failure to save her stays explicit.

rows.en: Daisuke! A Giganos Metal Armor squad is heading this way!
rows.notes: Umon interrupts Daisuke's recollection with approaching Giganos Metal Armor warning.

rows.en: Giganos!? Why are they attacking this institute!?
rows.notes: Daisuke asks why Giganos would attack the institute; attack action restored from warning and following reply.

rows.en: They may be after Grendizer, or the data we have on aliens!
rows.notes: Umon proposes possible enemy targets; alien data belongs to the institute, not data about Giganos.

rows.en: We'll take defensive positions at once and ask the Nahel Argama for help!
rows.notes: Umon declares collective defensive action and a request to Nahel Argama for aid.

rows.en: Dad, you can't do that! They're after Kaine and the others' D-Weapons...
rows.notes: Daisuke stops his father from summoning help; enemy target is Kaine's group and their D-Weapons; source trailing pause retained.

rows.en: They probably mean to lure them here, then attack them while using the institute as a shield!
rows.notes: Daisuke explains the trap: lure Kaine's group, use institute as shield, attack that group. Probably retains conjecture.

rows.en: I'll handle this on my own! I'll find a way!
rows.notes: Daisuke promises to handle enemy attack alone, restoring I and the action.

rows.en: Wait! Wait, Daisuke!!
rows.notes: Umon tries to stop Daisuke leaving; imperative directed to son.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!

Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full [jp] remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Enemy unit reaches the Institute of Space Science@2. Grendizer is shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat-condition list, two segments retained. Full Institute of Space Science spelling preserved. Measured first segment overflow; removed only indefinite article An.

rows.en: Captain, that's the Institute of Space Science!
rows.notes: Dan identifies target institute to Captain Meio.

rows.en: Then we will now seize the institute.
rows.notes: Meio orders occupation of the institute; we restores squad action.

rows.en: Yes, sir!
Hm!? Wait, Captain! I'm picking up a heat signature near the dam!
rows.notes: Karl stops Meio with a heat detection near the dam; detecting action restored.

rows.en: Grendizer, go!!
rows.notes: Duke's Grendizer launch call, unchanged unit spelling.

rows.en: What is that thing...!?
rows.notes: Dan's astonished question identifies approaching machine, without adding its name.

rows.en: It looks like a super robot. I never expected them to have something like that stationed at the institute...
rows.notes: Welner classifies Grendizer as a super robot and expresses surprise at institute deployment.

rows.en: According to our scouts, it was aboard the Nahel Argama, operating alongside the D-Weapons.
rows.notes: Karl cites scouts: Grendizer operated alongside D-Weapons on Nahel Argama; not a separate scouting order.

rows.en: Then that's convenient. We may be able to lure the D-Weapons out with this.
rows.notes: Welner sees Grendizer as bait for the D-Weapons; speculative may retained.

rows.en: Good. Vanguard, target that super robot. Begin the attack!
rows.notes: Meio orders vanguard to target super robot and commence attack.

rows.en: I won't let you have your way! Here I come!
rows.notes: Duke denies enemy freedom of action and announces his own attack.

rows.en: We can no longer continue fighting!? All units, fall back!
rows.notes: Standalone withdrawal event: Meio assesses inability to continue fighting, orders every unit back.

rows.en: Come get me, you hawk bastard!
rows.notes: Kaine's insult is directed at Meio's Hawk epithet; force preserved.

rows.en: Boy, I'll give you credit for how well you've done so far... But this is the end!
rows.notes: Meio grudgingly credits Kaine's survival/performance before a final threat.

rows.en: Every time someone says that to me, it never actually happens!
rows.notes: Kaine counters Meio's this-is-the-end threat; actual failure of previous threats remains explicit.

rows.en: You just won't give up! If you want to cling to us that badly, change your name from Blue Hawk to Blue Octopus!
rows.notes: Kaine mocks Meio's clinging pursuit with Blue Hawk to Blue Octopus renaming; literal animal joke preserved.

rows.en: Heh... It seems your mouth is the only thing that's improved.
rows.notes: Meio answers Kaine's taunt: only his verbal ability has improved, not combat skill.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Kaine's shocked response to Meio's dismissal.

rows.en: You don't understand the gap in our abilities. A fool who mistakes recklessness for courage is no match for me!
rows.notes: Meio asserts ability gap and distinguishes courage from recklessness; direct insult retained.

rows.en: Come on, Barendos! I'll take you on!
rows.notes: Battle pairing changes to Duke and Barendos; Duke invites combat, not aid.

rows.en: Keep blustering, Duke Fleed! I'll make this planet your grave!
rows.notes: Barendos threatens Duke's death on Earth; named Duke Fleed kept.

rows.en: Barendos! Has the Vegan Empire already built a forward base in the Earth Sphere!?
rows.notes: Duke asks about a Vegan forward base already established within Earth Sphere.

rows.en: You're quite perceptive. But even if you knew, what would you do about it?
rows.notes: Barendos acknowledges Duke's perceptiveness, then challenges what knowing location would accomplish.

rows.en: Isn't it obvious!? I'll storm that base alone if I have to, and crush your evil ambitions!
rows.notes: Duke promises assault even alone and destruction of enemy's evil ambitions; base referent restored.

rows.en: You'd better surrender right now if you know what's good for you, Barendos!
rows.notes: Koji advises immediate surrender as taunting threat to Barendos.

rows.en: You irritating little saucer... I'll swat you out of the sky!
rows.notes: Barendos dismisses Koji's tiny saucer and threatens to shoot him down.

rows.en: Try it if you can! Underestimate me and you'll be sorry!
rows.notes: Koji challenges Barendos to try and warns against underestimating him.

rows.en: Oh... You're challenging me in that pathetic saucer...? What is your name?
rows.notes: Barendos belittles Koji's saucer and demands Koji's name.

rows.en: Remember it! I'm Koji Kabuto... the man who's going to drive you off Earth!
rows.notes: Koji supplies full Koji Kabuto name and pledges to eject enemy from Earth; male term sourced from self-description.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... I'll remember your name... as a reckless, suicidal idiot!
rows.notes: Barendos promises to remember Koji as a fool indifferent to death; insulting force retained.

rows.en: W-what did you saaaay!!
rows.notes: Koji's stuttering elongated angry shout preserved.

rows.en: This machine... isn't like a super robot, either...! Could it have been built beyond Earth!?
rows.notes: Meio recognizes machine as unlike familiar super robots and asks if built off Earth.

rows.en: That's right! Grendizer was the guardian deity of Planet Fleed!
rows.notes: Duke confirms extraterrestrial origin and Grendizer's former role protecting Planet Fleed.

rows.en: Planet Fleed!? Then you are...
rows.notes: Meio's recognition deliberately trails off after inferring Duke's identity.

rows.en: Earth is my second home... If you mean to defile it, you'll have to face me!
rows.notes: Duke defends second home Earth; anyone who defiles it must face him.

rows.en: This man... He's an alien, yet he cares so much about Earth...
rows.notes: Thought: Meio marvels at alien Duke's concern for Earth; original trailing reflection retained with explicit concern verb.

rows.en: But I must defeat him. I am a soldier of United Lunar Empire Giganos!
rows.notes: Thought: Meio reasserts duty to defeat Duke as United Empire Giganos soldier. Coordinator delta: Full organization name follows explicit Akurasu faction heading, superseding compact glossary form; source-short forms unchanged.

rows.en: If you side with the Earth Federation, you're our enemy!
rows.notes: Welner declares Duke an enemy if allied with Earth Federation.

rows.en: I fight for what I believe in... for the Earth!
rows.notes: Duke states personal convictions and defense of Earth as motives.

rows.en: If Giganos destroys nature and threatens people's lives, I won't let you get away with it!
rows.notes: Duke warns Giganos against nature destruction and threats to people's lives.

rows.en: Why is the Giganos Empire attacking the Institute of Space Science!?
rows.notes: Duke asks Karl why Giganos is attacking the institute.

rows.en: You're helping the Earth Federation! That alone is enough to warrant a purge!
rows.notes: Karl says cooperation with Earth Federation warrants purging; harsh purge retained.

rows.en: Then tell me this! Why drag civilians into the war between the Federation government and Giganos!?
rows.notes: Duke presses Karl about dragging civilians into Federation government/Giganos war.

rows.en: If you make innocent people suffer to achieve your ideals, I'll risk my life to fight you!
rows.notes: Duke vows to risk his life opposing ideals implemented through innocent people's suffering.

rows.en: Even a heavily armored super robot is helpless against our teamwork!
rows.notes: Dan says combined squad tactics overcome even heavy armor.

rows.en: Don't underestimate Grendizer! If you attack, I won't back down a single step!
rows.notes: Duke warns against underestimating Grendizer and promises not to retreat if attacked.

rows.en: Damn... I can't get a bead on him when he's moving this fast!
rows.notes: Tapp cannot aim at rapidly moving Meio; sourced male speaker profile permits him.

rows.en: You amateur! You don't even know how to make the most of D-2's firepower!
rows.notes: Meio criticizes Tapp's inability to exploit D-2 firepower.

rows.en: D-3...! If I shoot you down, the D-Weapons' fighting strength will drop to less than half!
rows.notes: Meio targets Light's D-3 to cut combined D-Weapons combat strength below half, not exactly half.

rows.en: Damn... He sure knows what he's doing! This guy's tough!
rows.notes: Light recognizes Meio knows the team's vulnerability; his opponent is challenging.

rows.en: Why are you targeting the Institute of Space Science!? This is a civilian facility!
rows.notes: Judau challenges attack on explicitly civilian Institute of Space Science.

rows.en: A child has no business interfering! This is all part of our strategy!
rows.notes: Meio dismisses child Judau and justifies attack as strategy.

rows.en: So you're doing this because you were ordered to...! The Blue Hawk of Giganos is just another soldier after all!
rows.notes: Judau interprets strategy defense as mere obedience; mocks heroic Blue Hawk epithet.

rows.en: Here I come, Blue Tri-Stars!
rows.notes: Judau deliberately calls Practice Squad Blue Tri-Stars; source parody preserved, confirmed by root.

rows.en: No, no, Judau. They're the Practice Squad.
rows.notes: Light corrects Judau to Practice Squad; correction remains linked to preceding joke.

rows.en: This Gundam... Are you Domon Kasshu, the King of Hearts!?
rows.notes: Meio identifies Domon Kasshu by Gundam and King of Hearts title.

rows.en: That's right! Giganos, you threaten Earth's nature and its people! In the name of the Shuffle, I'll defeat you!
rows.notes: Domon condemns Giganos's threat to nature and people and vows defeat in the Shuffle's name.

rows.en: Just as you believe in your own justice, I have ideals of my own! Anyone who stands in their way... I'll cut down!
rows.notes: Meio counters Domon's justice with his own ideals and threatens to cut down anyone obstructing them.

rows.en: Attacking while we're away is a dirty trick! The Blue Hawk of Giganos? What a joke!
rows.notes: Koji condemns timing of attack in their absence and mocks Blue Hawk of Giganos reputation.

rows.en: For now, I will bear that disgrace... All for Giganos's victory!
rows.notes: Meio accepts present dishonor for Giganos victory, answering Koji's accusation.

rows.en: Why is the Giganos Empire attacking the Institute of Space Science, a civilian facility!?
rows.notes: Ryoma challenges attack on civilian institute, preserving explicit civilian status.

rows.en: I have no obligation to answer that question. I am simply carrying out my mission!
rows.notes: Meio refuses explanation and says he is carrying out his mission; stray Japanese closing wrapper ignored.

rows.en: A super robot that's not in our data... Is it a new model!?
rows.notes: Meio notices undocumented super robot and asks if a new model; machine stays unnamed.

rows.en: Damn it! I don't care if you're the Blue Hawk of Giganos or whatever! Get down here!
rows.notes: Ginga demands aerial opponent descend; next Hokuto joke confirms literal downward movement.

rows.en: But, Ginga... If he comes down to the ground, he won't be a hawk anymore.
rows.notes: Answers Ginga's command in239 with a literal hawk joke.

rows.en: Stop nitpicking every little stupid thing! Anyway, let's go!!
That mobility...! No wonder they call him the Blue Hawk!
If we let this turn into a speed contest, we'll just destroy ourselves! We've got to stop him moving!
Stop ordering me around all the time!
Vegan Empire! You still haven't learned your lesson, have you? You're attacking us again!
Damn Getter Robo... Don't underestimate our power!
I'll send you to hell too... just like that Musashi Tomoe fellow!
rows.notes: Full Musashi Tomoe name is explicitly spoken; death threat retained.

rows.en: You bastard... I'll never forgive you!
G-Genzo Umon! Something terrible's happened!
rows.notes: Honorific name follows locked Genzo Umon convention.

rows.en: What's wrong!?
I haven't seen Hikaru for a while! Has she come back here!?
N-no...
Aaaah!!
Is that Hikaru!? She was still outside!
What? A civilian?
A-aah...!
Look out, Hikaru!
You fool! You came flying right into our fire!
rows.notes: Welner taunts Duke for moving into the attackers' fire to rescue Hikaru.

rows.en: Th-that robot...!!
rows.notes: Recognition trails off; do not disclose the pilot here.

rows.en: Hikaru, run while you have the chance!!
Huh!? H-how do you know my name...!? And that voice... I've heard it before...
rows.notes: Voice recognition deliberately trails off.
Deliberate silence.

rows.en: Vanguard! Concentrate your fire on the super robot!
Ugh!!
W-who... who are you!?
I'll shield you! Hurry and run!
Y-yes!
I knew it! That voice is...!
rows.notes: Thought: recognition deliberately trails off without naming Duke.

rows.en: He can't move! Don't waste this chance! Fire!
G-ghhh!!
He risks his own life to shield a civilian in this situation. An enemy he may be, but I admire him.
rows.notes: Meio admires the enemy Duke's self-sacrifice while Duke shields Hikaru.

rows.en: I won't submit to people like you...! People who destroy Earth's greenery with a Mass Driver!
rows.notes: Duke rejects Giganos, whose Mass Driver destroys Earth's greenery.

rows.en: What nonsense. You are the true destroyers of Earth's environment, living idly under the Federation's corrupt regime.
rows.notes: Meio redirects Duke's charge against the Federation and its people.

rows.en: The Earth Sphere can no longer survive without us Giganos ruling it...
rows.notes: Earth Sphere restored as the sentence subject.

rows.en: And without a great leader like His Excellency Marshal Guiltorre, it can only hurtle down the road to destruction.
rows.notes: Earth Sphere remains the subject from274.

rows.en: How dare you say that when you don't even cherish your own home planet!
rows.notes: Duke addresses Giganos pilots, who neglect their own home world.

rows.en: I'll never accept a rule that sacrifices human lives and nature!
The Nahel Argama...! You all came...
rows.notes: Duke addresses the arriving allied group, not the ship itself.

rows.en: Giganos attacked this place, instead of the Vegan Empire...!
Whew... I'm glad I linked little Maggie to the site network.
rows.notes: Maggie is Light's computer nickname; little preserves affectionate chan.

rows.en: All units, launch immediately!
Are you all right, Duke Fleed!?
I'm fine. More importantly, I'm counting on you to protect the institute!
rows.notes: Duke asks Koji/allies to protect the institute; request direction retained.

rows.en: Heh... So you've come, Dragonar.
You Giganos bastards! Now that we're here, we won't let you do as you please!
All units! Defend the Institute of Space Science and intercept the enemy units!
1. Enemy unit reaches Institute of Space Science@2. Grendizer is shot down@3. Allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat conditions; preserves two @ breaks. Provisional 352px each.

rows.en: Dad! Genzo Umon!
Oh, Hikaru!
I'm glad you're safe, Hikaru.
But, Doctor! What is that robot that saved me!?
I've seen it come out of the institute before, but...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing but preserved.

rows.en: The person piloting it... Could it be...!?
rows.notes: Pilot recognition stays unfinished and unidentified.

rows.en: Hm!? This is...! Maggie, give me the detailed data!
rows.notes: Light requests data from Maggie, his computer.

rows.en: Everyone, listen! I've picked up a group of flying objects approaching us!
Who are they!?
In a situation like this, you can bet they're the enemy!
Besides, Maggie estimates they're alien weapons!
Could it be the Vegan Empire!?
rows.notes: Thought kind retained.

rows.en: Light, who's Maggie!?
I'll explain the details later! For now, stay alert!
rows.notes: Light promises later explanation and tells everyone to remain alert.

rows.en: Light, who is this Maggie!?
Everyone, those flying objects are coming in! Be careful!
It is the Vegan Empire after all!
Those are the aliens that just showed up...!?
Duke Fleed! Today, I'll finally destroy you and Grendizer!!
Don't think it'll go like last time, Barendos! I won't hand this green Earth over to you!
rows.notes: Duke alludes to an earlier fight; no invented explanation.

rows.en: Like last time... What do you mean!?
Does Daisuke know that Vega bastard?
Who knows... Maybe they fought before he joined us.
rows.notes: Light offers a tentative prior-fight explanation, not certainty.

rows.en: No, that's not it...
rows.notes: Thought; removed stray source closing wrapper.

rows.en: I get the feeling Daisuke has known about the Vegan Empire for much longer...!
rows.notes: Ryoma suspects longer-standing knowledge, not just a recent fight.

rows.en: Anyway, let's drive those Vega bastards out too!!
It doesn't really matter, but "Vega bastards"... That rubs me the wrong way.
rows.notes: Thought; keeps literal Vega in insult so same-name joke survives.

rows.en: Hm? Vega, what's wrong?
Oh, it's nothing. Anyway, Hokuto, Ginga... You mustn't let them take the institute!
rows.notes: Vega tells both children to prevent enemy capture of the institute.

rows.en: Yeah, I know! Hokuto, make sure you get your timing right!
rows.notes: Ginga tells Hokuto to synchronize timing.

rows.en: Hey, why are you spacing out!? Are you still fretting about it!?
rows.notes: Ginga addresses distracted Hokuto; prior worries intentionally unnamed.
Thought: deliberate unfinished I... retained.

rows.en: All units, ignore the Giganos forces! Our targets are Grendizer and the Institute of Space Science!
Come on, bring it on!
That presence... They're after the Institute of Space Science as well as Grendizer.
rows.notes: Domon senses enemy intent; retains perceptual lead-in.

rows.en: Yes...! Everyone, I'm sorry to ask, but I need your help.
rows.notes: Duke requests help from allies; request direction explicit.

rows.en: I know, Duke Fleed!
Daisuke, please don't push yourself too hard either!
rows.notes: Also/either preserves reciprocal caution.

rows.en: The way they're moving... They're after the institute as well as Grendizer.
I knew it! Daisuke is the one piloting that robot...!
And Koji called him Duke Fleed...
Daisuke... Who are you, really?
Clever trick... We'll settle this another time!
rows.notes: Meio defers the duel; addressed opponent remains unstated as in source.

rows.en: Clever trick... Dragonar, we'll settle this another time!
rows.notes: Parallel event explicitly addresses Dragonar.

rows.en: All enemy units have withdrawn!
Good... Land near the institute and recover all our units.
Daisuke, you're...
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished identity question.
Brief affirmative reply to identity question; source fragment retained.

rows.en: My name is Duke Fleed... The real Daisuke Umon is an alien from Planet Fleed.
An alien...! Daisuke is...?
rows.notes: Deliberate stunned echo fragment.

rows.en: ...Please listen, Hikaru...
My home, Planet Fleed, was destroyed by the Vegan Empire, those devils of space.
I escaped my home with Grendizer... and eventually made it here to Earth.
Then... I took the name Daisuke Umon and lived as an Earthling...
Why did you...?
rows.notes: Restores did you while preserving unfinished why question.

rows.en: The Vegan Empire is after Grendizer, which was built as Planet Fleed's guardian...
So I had to hide the truth from the people around me... especially those close to me.
Because of that, I ended up hurting you and Danbei...
It's understandable... Even after contact with the Baam, many people on Earth still haven't accepted that aliens exist...
rows.notes: Daisuke interprets Hikaru silence before her reply reverses that interpretation.

rows.en: Thank you...

rows.notes: Source nonverbal exclamation retained.

rows.en: I understand now. You kept everything to yourself because you were thinking of us, Daisuke.
And the person who saved me was the Daisuke I know so well.
I'm glad you understand. But I'm Duke Fleed... I'm not an Earthling.
No, I love Daisuke Umon. So Daisuke is enough for me.
rows.notes: Hikaru affection rendered love in the intimate declaration; does not add alien explanation.
uncertain: Hikaru suki permits like/love; intimate acceptance of Daisuke favors love.

rows.en: Thank you... Hikaru.
Koji, is that story... really true?
Yeah... Daisuke is from Planet Fleed... and what's more, he was a prince.
So... I was right after all.
He's just like me, too...
rows.notes: Vega unspoken personal parallel deliberately remains unfinished and unexplained.

rows.en: Well, anyway... We sort of had a feeling that was the case, right?
Yeah. Grendizer didn't look like a machine from Earth, either.
And Daisuke suddenly transformed right before the battle, too.
rows.notes: And/either retained as continuation of reasons for suspicion.

rows.en: Anyway, I'm glad we've cleared up all those questions.
You said it was important, so I was expecting something more surprising.
Huh!? Y-you guys... That's all?
Look, did you really think something like that would change the way we see him?
Aliens aren't exactly rare these days, you know.
That's right. We've got the Baam here, too.
We've fought fossils and lizards. This story is almost a letdown for us.
rows.notes: Literal fossils/lizards preserves Hayato flippant wording without adding identities.

rows.en: Heh, heh heh...
rows.notes: Laughter only.

rows.en: What's wrong?
Oh, so I was worrying for nothing. Right, of course. Heh heh heh.
It's nothing to be surprised about at this point, is it? Ha ha!
rows.notes: Koji relief continues laughter.

rows.en: What's with you? You're acting weird.
Anyway, Koji, you should've trusted us. Keeping quiet about it all this time...
rows.notes: Trailing accusation kept, with subject and action restored.

rows.en: Yeah. You could've told us sooner, you know.
Sorry, sorry.
rows.notes: Apology repeated as source.

rows.en: These kids... They might accept us for who we are, too...
rows.notes: Vega plural us preserved without disclosing family or origins.

rows.en: Everyone...
rows.notes: Vocative only.

rows.en: Oh, here's the prince we were talking about.
Daisuke... No, Duke Fleed. They understand.
Thank you... everyone...

rows.notes: Interrupted I fragment retained; Kaine cuts off speech.

rows.en: Hey, let's skip the sappy stuff. You're Duke Fleed and Daisuke Umon. That's fine, isn't it?
I wouldn't be surprised if you had another name, either.
...Um, Daisuke.
rows.notes: Hesitant vocative only.

rows.en: Hokuto...
rows.notes: Vocative only.

rows.en: Daisuke, do you hate the Vegan Empire?
Hokuto...
rows.notes: Vega privately addresses Hokuto by name; thought kind retained; hidden identity stays hidden.

rows.en: Please tell me. Can't you fight unless you hate your enemy?
rows.notes: Hokuto asks Daisuke for an answer; generic fight retains listener-centered query.

rows.en: ...It's true that I feel anger and hatred toward the Vegan Empire.
But, Hokuto... That's not all there is to it.
Huh...?
rows.notes: Reaction only.

rows.en: I want to bring peace back to Earth, my second home... to this land.
For that, I'll face anyone without fear, no matter who they are.

rows.notes: Hokuto unfinished response.

rows.en: You don't have to understand yet. But I'm sure you'll find it, too... your reason to fight.
And just as Grendizer was given to me...
rows.notes: Sentence deliberately continues into397.

rows.en: There must be a reason Dendoh was given to you. So you mustn't run away from it.
rows.notes: It refers to the significance/duty of receiving Dendoh, not a new literal enemy.
uncertain: From it refers broadly to the meaning/responsibility of receiving Dendoh; source does not name a narrower duty.

rows.en: I understand. I'll... try my best.
...It looks like Hokuto will be all right.
rows.notes: Context settles Hokuto as the person reassured.

rows.en: Heh, looks like Hokuto's cleared his head, too.
rows.notes: Ginga reacts to Hokuto's newfound resolve in rows398-399; restores the contextual subject. 'Too' contrasts with the earlier cleared-up mystery. Referent inference documented in report.
uncertain: The contextual subject of this-side relief is inferred as Hokuto from his immediately preceding resolve; source itself uses a deictic expression.

rows.en: Oh, right. Light... who's this Maggie you mentioned earlier?
Oh, that's D-3's interactive computer.
rows.notes: Light answers Ginga; 'that's' identifies Maggie as a computer, without a gendered pronoun.

rows.en: Wow...
By the way, D-1's computer is called Clara.
rows.notes: Supplies the context-settled noun computer and verb rather than rendering the source nominally.

rows.en: D-2's computer is named Sonia.
rows.notes: The name belongs to D-2's computer, not D-2 itself.

rows.en: If it's interactive... it must have a high-performance AI, too, right?
rows.notes: Aqua asks Light whether the interactive computer also has advanced AI; speaker runtime placeholder preserved.

rows.en: That's right. You can perform quite a lot of operations with voice input.
rows.notes: Light answers Aqua; generic operator 'you' makes the ability explicit.

rows.en: #女愛称, are you interested in that sort of thing?
rows.notes: Kaine addresses Aqua; exact runtime placeholder retained in body.

rows.en: Yes. My machine has an AI, too, though it isn't interactive...
rows.notes: Aqua answers Kaine; preserves the trailing continuation, identifies the installed equipment as AI from row405.

rows.en: Besides, my instructor at the military academy was an expert in that field.
rows.notes: Aqua gives a further reason for her interest; instructor gender remains unspecified.

rows.en: Oh, really...
rows.notes: Kaine's intrigued interjection, not an omitted proposition.

rows.en: All right, everyone. The Nahel Argama will be departing soon.
We'll be heading out again as soon as our next patrol area is assigned, so get ready.
rows.notes: Vega orders everyone to prepare; the group will sortie again after the patrol assignment. Genuine command retains imperative direction.

rows.en: Roger!
rows.notes: Acknowledgment interjection.

rows.en: Well, Daisuke, shall we get going, too?
Yeah...
rows.notes: Agreement interjection with source trailing pause.

rows.en: ...We kind of had a feeling, didn't we?
rows.notes: Alternate branch reacts to Daisuke's alien identity; original following Judau and Kaine lines confirm shared prior suspicions.

rows.en: Well, now that my questions are answered, I feel a lot better.
rows.notes: Tapp is relieved the mystery about Daisuke has been answered; restores first-person experiencer.

rows.en: Aliens aren't exactly rare these days, after all.
I... I've been surrounded by such wonderful friends all along...
rows.notes: Daisuke's grateful private reflection; preserves repeated first person and thought kind.

rows.en: Oh, right. This is a change of subject, but...
rows.notes: Elle explicitly changes the subject and trails into row421; source continuation retained.

rows.en: Who's this Maggie you were talking about, Light?
Oh, that's D-3's interactive piloting computer.
rows.notes: Unlike row402, this source explicitly specifies piloting, retained here.

rows.en: Oh, huh...
So this is where you all were.
What's the matter, Sergeant?
rows.notes: Tapp addresses Ben by Sergeant; full question restored.

rows.en: Our next patrol area has been assigned. Recheck your machines right away.
rows.notes: Ben orders the Dragonar pilots to inspect their machines again immediately; imperative direction preserved.

rows.en: Ugh, we don't even get a break?
rows.notes: Tapp complains about lack of rest; first-person plural restored.

rows.en: Get your hands moving before your mouth!
rows.notes: Ben's sharp rebuke uses the source hands/mouth contrast as a command to work first.

rows.en: Roger, roger!
rows.notes: Repeated acknowledgment retained.
